label: Port 18091
type: the TLS-secured Couchbase Web Console / Cluster Manager REST port. The secure counterpart of the cleartext 8091.
note: The first member of a port: namespace, promoted because on-the-wire-security.md's TLS and cipher settings are stated per-port and there was previously nowhere to hang them. A small namespace that will grow: Couchbase's port matrix is large and entirely absent from the registry so far.
